import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

# Suppress warnings and tqdm progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL"] = "2"

# Define paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
template_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

# Identify label columns and ID column
label_cols = [c for c in template_df.columns if c != "id"]
id_col = "id"
text_col = "comment_text"

print(f"Columns detected: {label_cols}")

# Prepare training data
X_train_raw = train_df[text_col].tolist()
y_train_matrix = train_df[label_cols].values.astype(float)

# Split train data for validation
# We use a hold-out split from the labeled training data
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw,
    y_train_matrix,
    test_size=0.15,
    stratify=y_train_matrix.ravel(),
    random_state=42,
)

# Vectorize
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2)
)
X_train_vect = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_split)
X_val_vect = vectorizer.transform(X_val_split)
X_test_vect = vectorizer.transform(test_df[text_col].tolist())

# Initialize and train models for each label
models = {}
auc_scores = []

for i, col in enumerate(label_cols):
    # Prepare y for this class
    y_one_hot_binary = y_train_matrix[:, i].astype(int)

    # LightGBM params optimized for speed/balance
    param = {"objective": "binary", "metric": "binary_logloss"}
    # Add learning rate control for depth/accuracy balance
    param.update(
        {
            "num_leaves": 100,
            "learning_rate": 0.02,
            "feature_fraction": 0.9,
            "bagging_fraction": 0.9,
            "verbose": -1,
        }
    )

    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_vect, label=y_one_hot_binary)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val_vect, label=y_val_split[:, i], reference=train_data)

    model = lgb.train(
        param,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=500,
        valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
        callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],  # Silence logs
        seed=42,
    )
    models[col] = model
    auc_scores.append(model.eval_set([val_data])["auc"])

# Compute Mean ROC AUC on Validation Set
# Average of individual AUCs
mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Mean Validation AUC: {mean_auc}")

# Generate Predictions for Test Set
predictions = np.zeros((len(test_df), len(label_cols)))
for i, col in enumerate(label_cols):
    preds = models[col].predict(X_test_vect)
    predictions[:, i] = preds

# Save Submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(predictions, columns=label_cols)
submission_df.insert(0, id_col, test_df[id_col])
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_FILE}")
print(f"Training completed. Evaluation Metric: {mean_auc:.6f}")
